description: public.utf8-plain-text from the macOS general pasteboard (2 items)
how: Created /private/tmp/rclip-capture/files/{alpha.txt,beta.txt}, opened that folder in Finder, selected both, Edit > Copy. Two NSPasteboardItems, one per file.
notes: Finder's textual form of the selection is the display names separated by CR (0x0d) - not LF, and not the URLs. Only item 0 carries it; item 1 has the file URL alone.
